```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

# Illustrative data—not actual Avenue Shabu data
promotion_data <- data.frame(
  campaign = c(
    "BOGO Offer",
    "Influencer Campaign",
    "Holiday Promotion",
    "No Promotion"
  ),
  revenue = c(24500, 22000, 27000, 19000),
  food_cost = c(7800, 7000, 8800, 6000),
  labor_cost = c(6500, 6200, 7200, 5800),
  marketing_cost = c(1800, 1500, 2200, 0)
) |>
  mutate(
    contribution_margin =
      revenue - food_cost - labor_cost - marketing_cost
  )
```

## Row {height="25%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(
  title = "Total Revenue",
  value = dollar(sum(promotion_data$revenue)),
  icon = "cash-stack",
  color = "#6f263d"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(
  title = "Average Revenue",
  value = dollar(mean(promotion_data$revenue)),
  icon = "bar-chart",
  color = "#b88632"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(
  title = "Contribution Margin",
  value = dollar(sum(promotion_data$contribution_margin)),
  icon = "graph-up-arrow",
  color = "#8f4b5f"
)
```

## Row {height="75%"}

### Revenue by Campaign

```{r}
ggplot(
  promotion_data,
  aes(x = reorder(campaign, revenue), y = revenue, fill = campaign)
) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "BOGO Offer" = "#8f4b5f",
      "Influencer Campaign" = "#b88632",
      "Holiday Promotion" = "#6f263d",
      "No Promotion" = "#d9c3b8"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Revenue",
    caption = "Illustrative data only"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Campaign Summary

```{r}
promotion_data |>
  select(campaign, revenue, marketing_cost, contribution_margin) |>
  mutate(
    revenue = dollar(revenue),
    marketing_cost = dollar(marketing_cost),
    contribution_margin = dollar(contribution_margin)
  ) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Campaign",
      "Revenue",
      "Marketing Cost",
      "Contribution Margin"
    )
  )
```

::: callout-note
The values shown in this dashboard are illustrative. They are not actual Avenue Shabu financial results.
:::
